content: For example, reading the five example sentences containing consolidation, one can judge that consolidation is a typical manifestation of COVID-19. This is in accordance with the conclusion in BIBREF5: “Consolidation becomes the dominant CT findings as the disease progresses." Similarly, the example sentences of pleural effusion, ground glass opacity, thickening, fibrosis, bronchiectasis, lymphadenopathy show that these abnormalities are closely related with COVID-19. This is consistent with the results reported in the literature:
